_comment: Copy this file to config.ids.local.json (gitignored) and fill in real Google Drive IDs. The build embeds these into dist/Setup.gs (feature-scoped). Run setupLegalAppsSuiteScriptProperties() once per Apps Script project to populate Script Properties. Owning features: RECOVERY_DOCUMENT_TEMPLATES -> recoveries/recovery-document-generator, REPAIRER_MAP -> recoveries/repairer-sync, MONEY_TALKS_SETTLEMENT_RELEASE_TEMPLATE_ID -> money-talks/settlement-release-generator, MONEY_TALKS_INVOICE_TEMPLATES -> money-talks/invoice-generator.
